claim_boundary: This repairs the torus common-zero argument for all 803 formerly pending two-minor rows in families (2,4), (2,5), (3,3), and (4,2).
It proves no non-nilpotent rank-one family, arbitrary GL(6), ordinary lower 50, exact rank 64, or border-rank statement.
proof_method: Reconstruct both saved exact minors; remove each invertible coordinate monomial; verify that the residual exponent lattice is generated by (1,1,0,...); and compute gcd 1 in Q[z] for z=p0*p1.
